activity_summary: Two bills were on the Bishopsgate post for the first time since Midsummer week, both black-letter: your lord's servants and my Lord Admiral's. You read the Rose's first, as always. It reassured you and irritated you in about equal parts.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the post, and went home.

entities.name: the Rose
entities.context: Mentioned in Two bills on the post
